pullQuote: A referee who never blows the whistle is a shill. The graveyard is open; it's waiting.

entries.name: Cottage cheese taco shells
entries.line: Legitimately good protein delivery — just don't expect a corn tortilla. Rack-crisping is non-negotiable.

entries.name: Yogurt tiramisu
entries.note: Biscoff + Greek yogurt, overnight — the no-bake of the summer
entries.line: The rare viral dessert that's better than its video. Two-second dunks and an overnight chill are the whole game.

entries.name: Buldak carbonara
entries.line: One sauce packet plus the dairy is dinner; two packets is a challenge video. Numbers: 2 yolks, 40g parm, off the heat.

entries.name: Frozen yogurt clusters
entries.note: high-protein freezer snack, chocolate shell that snaps
entries.line: Cool the melted chocolate 3 minutes before dipping — that's the difference between a shell and a milkshake.

entries.name: Chickpea cookie dough
entries.line: Nobody guesses the chickpeas. Three full minutes in the processor or it's hummus with chocolate chips.

entries.name: Black sesame anything
entries.note: the flavor of 2026, still at all-time-high interest
entries.line: Tastes sophisticated, bakes like a snickerdoodle. Weigh the flour: 160g, not a scoop.

entries.name: Air fryer smashed potatoes
entries.note: the default potato of the app
entries.line: Fork-tender before smashing, steam-dry after draining. The crunch has a 15-minute half-life.

entries.name: Watermelon feta salad
entries.line: Drain the melon 10 minutes or serve a pink puddle. The doubters go quiet after one bite.

entries.name: Dubai chocolate bar
entries.note: a grocery SKU now, but homemade still wins
entries.line: Rebuilt with real pistachio cream — the jar costs more than the chocolate, and it's still worth it.

entries.name: Protein ice cream
entries.note: the Creami-era version, with math that survives arithmetic
entries.line: The viral version claims 25g protein and delivers 13. Ours delivers 25 because we used two scoops. Arithmetic.

entries.name: Cottage cheese flatbread
entries.line: A solid high-protein wrap. Anyone calling it 'bread' is lying to you — it's a flat baked omelet, and that's fine.

entries.name: Roadhouse rolls + cinnamon honey butter
entries.note: the copycat that never stops trending

entries.name: Hugo spritz (+ zero-proof)
entries.note: elderflower spritz, the drink of the summer

entries.name: Swicy everything
entries.note: sweet-heat is the flavor direction of the year

entries.name: Crispy rice salad
entries.note: nam khao-inspired bowls all over the app
